title.en: Specialty Food Counter and Packing Assistant
title.zh: 特色食品柜台与包装助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Assemble approved gift-box orders and verify supplied product and allergen information.
requirements.zh: 组装获批礼盒订单，并核对提供的产品及过敏原信息。

requirements.en: Maintain order, payment-status and collection records while separating cancellations from completed collections.
requirements.zh: 维护订单、付款状态及领取记录，并区分取消订单与已完成领取。

requirements.en: Maintain clear collection shelves and shift handovers, referring substitutions to the responsible lead.
requirements.zh: 维护清晰取货架及轮班交接，并将替换事项转交负责主管。
